_note: Sous-ensemble de l'API Coolify utilisé par le portail. Sert aux tests : les charges utiles envoyées doivent respecter ces schémas (champs connus, types, valeurs d'énumération). À rafraîchir si l'API de Coolify évolue.

environment_name.description: The environment name. You need to provide at least one of environment_name or environment_uuid.

environment_uuid.description: The environment UUID. You need to provide at least one of environment_name or environment_uuid.

git_https_username.description: Username for HTTPS access to a private repository on a custom Git host (not github.com).

git_https_password.description: Password or access token for HTTPS access to a private repository on a custom Git host (not github.com). It is stored encrypted and never returned.

domains.description: The application URLs in a comma-separated list.

noindex_domains.description: The subset of the application domains served with an X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow response header, keeping them out of search engines. Entries that are not among the application domains are ignored.

is_static.description: The flag to indicate if the application is static.

is_spa.description: The flag to indicate if the application is a single-page application (SPA). Only relevant when is_static is true.

is_auto_deploy_enabled.description: The flag to indicate if auto-deploy is enabled on git push. Defaults to true.

is_force_https_enabled.description: The flag to indicate if HTTPS is forced. Defaults to true.

is_preview_deployments_enabled.description: Enable preview deployments for pull requests.

base_directory.description: The base directory for all commands.

health_check_start_period.description: Health check start period in seconds.

manual_webhook_secret_github.description: Manual webhook secret for Github. Needs the deploy ability.

manual_webhook_secret_gitlab.description: Manual webhook secret for Gitlab. Needs the deploy ability.

manual_webhook_secret_bitbucket.description: Manual webhook secret for Bitbucket. Needs the deploy ability.

manual_webhook_secret_gitea.description: Manual webhook secret for Gitea. Needs the deploy ability.

redirect.description: How to set redirect with Traefik / Caddy. www<->non-www.

instant_deploy.description: The flag to indicate if the application should be deployed instantly.

dockerfile_location.description: The Dockerfile location in the repository.

dockerfile_target_build.description: The Docker build target (stage) in the Dockerfile.

docker_compose_custom_start_command.description: The Docker Compose custom start command.

docker_compose_custom_build_command.description: The Docker Compose custom build command.

docker_compose_domains.description: Array of URLs to be applied to containers of a dockercompose application.

name.description: The service name as defined in docker-compose.

redirect.description: Per-service www/non-www redirect for this compose service.

watch_paths.description: Watch path patterns, one per line (newline-separated). Commas do not separate patterns.

use_build_secrets.description: Use Docker Build Secrets for build-time environment variables.

is_auto_cancel_queued_deployments_enable.description: Cancel older queued webhook deployments when a newer push arrives. Default: true.

is_auto_cancel_building_deployments_enab.description: Also stop an older webhook deployment that is still building when a newer push arrives. A deployment that already started to replace containers always finishes. This also cancels queued webhook deployments. Default: false.

inject_build_args_to_dockerfile.description: Inject build arguments into the Dockerfile build.

include_source_commit_in_build.description: Include the source commit in the build.

include_network_hosts_in_build.description: Add the containers of the destination network as build hosts.

redact_all_env_values_in_logs.description: Redact all environment variable values in logs. When false, only locked (shown once) values are redacted. Requires team admin permissions.

include_coolify_default_variables.description: Add the predefined COOLIFY_* variables (COOLIFY_URL, COOLIFY_FQDN, ...) to the environment. Requires team admin permissions. Redeploy to apply it.

stop_grace_period.description: Container stop grace period in seconds.

rolling_update_drain_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the new container is healthy before old containers stop during a rolling update. 0 turns the wait off. Default: 5.

docker_images_to_keep.description: Number of Docker images to retain.

is_permanent_redirect_enabled.description: Use permanent redirects (301/308) instead of temporary (302/307) for the HTTP to HTTPS and www redirects. Defaults to false.

traefik_certificate_resolver.description: Traefik certificate resolver for this application. Null uses the server setting, "none" uses no resolver.

is_container_label_readonly_enabled.description: Let Coolify manage the container labels. True regenerates custom_labels from domains, redirect, and proxy settings. False keeps custom_labels as you set them: domains, redirect, and basic auth changes then do not change the labels.

is_raw_compose_deployment_enabled.description: Deploy the raw Docker Compose definition.

is_log_drain_enabled.description: Enable log drain for the application.

is_consistent_container_name_enabled.description: Use a consistent container name across deployments.

is_image_scan_enabled.description: Scan the images of the application for vulnerabilities. Needs image scanning on the server. Default true.

custom_internal_name.description: Custom internal container name. Turns is_consistent_container_name_enabled on when that field is not sent; sending it as false together with a name returns 422.

custom_container_name_prefix.description: Prefix for generated container names (prefix-20260908T141530). Slugified and unique across the instance.

max_restart_count.description: Maximum container restart count before stopping.

http_basic_auth_hash_algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for the HTTP Basic Authentication password. Argon2id needs the Caddy proxy, version 2.11 or newer.

http_basic_auth_bcrypt_cost.description: Bcrypt cost for the HTTP Basic Authentication password.

http_basic_auth_argon2id_memory_cost.description: Argon2id memory cost in KiB for the HTTP Basic Authentication password.

http_basic_auth_argon2id_time_cost.description: Argon2id time cost (iterations) for the HTTP Basic Authentication password.

connect_to_docker_network.description: The flag to connect the service to the predefined Docker network.

force_domain_override.description: Force domain usage even if conflicts are detected. Default is false.

autogenerate_domain.description: If true and domains is empty, auto-generate a domain using the server's wildcard domain or sslip.io fallback. Ignored for the dockercompose build pack, which uses docker_compose_domains. Default: true.

is_container_label_escape_enabled.description: Escape special characters in labels. By default, $ (and other chars) is escaped. So if you write $ in the labels, it will be saved as $$. If you want to use env variables inside the labels, turn this off.

tags.description: Tags to assign to the application.

key.description: The key of the environment variable.

value.description: The value of the environment variable.

is_preview.description: The flag to indicate if the environment variable is used in preview deployments.

is_literal.description: The flag to indicate if the environment variable is a literal, nothing espaced.

is_multiline.description: The flag to indicate if the environment variable is multiline.

is_shown_once.description: If true, the saved value is hidden in the UI and API responses. A lock is permanent: false does not unlock a locked variable, but a new value can still replace the locked one. MCP never returns environment variable values.
